topNews.text: ‘Game-Changing’ Saliva Test Can Diagnose Endometriosis in Days Rather Than Years
topNews.excerpt: Two new rapid tests, EndoSure and Endotest, can drastically reduce the wait time for a proper diagnosis of endometriosis—from an average nine-year wait to just days. topNews.text: Scientists Have Found Climate-Resistant Coral Reefs Around the World Totaling the Size of Wisconsin
topNews.excerpt: A sophisticated AI-powered examination of coral reef resistance extrapolated into the future found that there’re about 64,000 square miles of coral reefs on Earth that could still be resisting climate change by 2050.
